title: What if Stanford was in Boston?
hook: We picked up Stanford, flew it across the country, and dropped it into a Boston winter. Here's what changes.
assumptions: Distance is the great-circle distance from Stanford, CA to Boston, MA (about 4,334 km), computed from coordinates, not a driving route.
Campus layout, weather effects on students, and rivalry outcomes are imagined for the story.

sources.claim: Stanford University is located in Stanford, California, next to Palo Alto
sources.title: Stanford Facts
